subject: general
question: If x+(1)/(x) = 3, x ≠ 0, then the value of x⁷+(1)/(x⁷) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If x + 1/x = k, then x³ + 1/x³ = k³ − 3k and x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = (k² − 2)² − 2.

For k = 3: x³ + 1/x³ = 3³ − 3(3) = 18.

x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = (3² − 2)² − 2 = 7² − 2 = 47.

x⁷ + 1/x⁷ = (x³ + 1/x³)(x⁴ + 1/x⁴) − (x + 1/x) = (18 × 47) − 3 = 846 − 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 843.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: x + 1/x = 3

Formula used: x⁷ + 1/x⁷ = (x³ + 1/x³)(x⁴ + 1/x⁴) − (x + 1/x)

⇒ Square both sides: (x + 1/x)² = 3²

⇒ x² + 1/x² + 2 = 9 ⇒ x² + 1/x² = 7

⇒ Cube both sides: (x + 1/x)³ = 3³

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ + 3(x + 1/x) = 27 ⇒ x³ + 1/x³ + 3(3) = 27 ⇒ x³ + 1/x³ = 18

⇒ Calculate x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = (x² + 1/x²)² − 2 = 7² − 2 = 47

⇒ x⁷ + 1/x⁷ = (18 × 47) − 3 = 846 − 3 = 843

**∴ The correct answer is 843.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Standard Algebraic Identities

If x + 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² − 2 and x³ + 1/x³ = k³ − 3k.

Higher Power Expressions

x⁵ + 1/x⁵ = (x² + 1/x²)(x³ + 1/x³) − (x + 1/x).

Negative Sign Variation

If x − 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² + 2 and x³ − 1/x³ = k³ + 3k.</p
